description: platformAutomerge MUST stay false: a ruleset bypass keys on the actor that PERFORMS the merge, and
GitHub-native auto-merge does not carry it. The pr-approval ruleset arriving
on master grants bypass to the renovate App as an Integration actor,
so renovate has to merge through its own API call -- as the App the bypass
names -- or its green batch sits waiting for a human approval that the
bypass was supposed to make unnecessary.
go.sum is written by `go mod tidy`, not by `go get`. Without gomodTidy renovate
adds the new version's hashes and leaves the old ones, and every recipe here
runs `just deps` -> `tidy` first, so every one of them rewrote go.sum and the
shared CI failed it as 'modified the working tree': #127 (github.com/truvity/audit
v0.2.5 -> v0.3.1) sat red on build, test, lint, ts, console and vuln for that
reason alone, holding back the ci-workflows pins that deliver this repository's

packageRules.description: MkDocs 2.0 breaks the plugins and theme overrides the documentation site (mkdocs.yaml, hack/mkdocs_hooks.py) is built with; hold it below 2 until they are ported.

The go directive is OWNED by devbox-update (ci-workflows v2.10.0): it aligns go.mod to the toolchain triple in the same PR as devbox.lock — language minor capped by golangci-lint's build Go, patch = the newest release of that line, never downward. Renovate leaves `go` alone so the three can never disagree (2026-08-23; replaces the bump rule and the minor/strict gates that papered over split ownership).
